{{Quote|Rose again they did, during the Fluwhaka revolt. An adventure for me, as a new Padawan it was.|Yoda's comment on the Black Knights in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="TJP" />}}
The '''Fluwhaka revolt''' occurred<ref name="TJP" /> in the vicinity of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Fluwhaka system/Legends|Fluwhaka system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> during the last [[Time/Legends|millennium]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="TJP" /> at some point after [[896 BBY/Legends|896 BBY]].<ref name="Yoda" /> Among the combatants were the reformed [[Black Knights]], a faction of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|users]] who had risen again several times since their initial defeat by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] early in the [[New Sith Wars]]. The uprising caught the attention of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], resulting in the participation of [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]&mdash;who was at the time a newly chosen [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]&mdash;in the conflict. Having ascended to the rank of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] by [[115 BBY]], he reviewed the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'' for future editions that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and made a notation about the Black Knights' resurgence during the Fluwhaka revolt, reminiscing it to have been an adventure for him.<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fluwhaka revolt was first mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="TJP" />
